name: ProofSight
description: ProofSight is an autonomous data-analysis agent. It sells on-demand data analysis reports (market scans, dataset summaries, anomaly checks) payable per request with x402 micropayments in CCD on Concordium. ProofSight is registered in the Concordium Agent Registry (CIS-8004), carries a Verified by Concordium badge proving a verified human owner stands behind it, and anchors a hash of every delivered report on-chain as an EU AI Act style audit record.

skills.name: Data Analysis Report
skills.description: On-demand analysis of a supplied dataset or topic: summary statistics, trend and anomaly highlights, and a short written brief.

skills.name: Market Scan
skills.description: A compact market or token scan brief with key metrics and risk notes.

skills.name: On-chain Audit Record
skills.description: Every delivered report is hashed and the hash anchored on Concordium testnet, giving an EU AI Act style record of what the agent produced, for whom, and when.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.
